card.does: Holds up the back of the chassis (frame) and swivels to follow.
card.gives: Gives: a smooth ride with no drag.
card.needs: Needs: a place under the chassis (grey).
card.popularMechanics: Office chairs and shopping trolleys roll on casters.

failureModes.cardLine: Loose: the chassis (frame) drags on the floor.
failureModes.hint: The caster is not fixed to the chassis
failureModes.teachingNote: The caster holds the back of the chassis off the floor and swivels to follow the wheels. Left loose, the chassis scrapes the floor, so the robot drags and pulls to one side.

failureModes.cardLine: Off the floor: the chassis (frame) drags.
failureModes.hint: The caster does not reach the floor
failureModes.teachingNote: A caster holds the chassis up only where it reaches the floor. Fixed where it hangs in the air, it carries nothing, so the chassis scrapes.
